title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: (19) lists six component maps (Θ_G, Θ_ρ, Θ_σ, χ, ε_2, ε_3) but the target as written shows only G_m × μ_2, with one factor illegible or crossed out. The target should contain two sign factors (μ_2 × μ_2), matching (μ, ε, ε') in (20).
In the kernel computation, χ appears to be partly struck in the first attempt ('Ker(Θ_G, ·ε_2, ε_3)'). The final line correctly uses (Θ_G, χ, ε_2, ε_3, Θ_ρ, Θ_σ).

Surjectivity requires extracting a square root λ of μ, so the image statement holds as fppf sheaves (or étale, if 2 is invertible), not pointwise over an arbitrary base. This is implicit and not stated.
The author himself notes on the previous page that he is 'getting lost' about the geometric meaning of SM_{ρ,σ} versus M_{ρ,σ}[0]. The notational framework is unsettled.

ideas.what: Embedding of an auxiliary linear group scheme M_{ρ,σ} as a closed subgroup of G × T_ρ × N'_σ, cut out by determinant and sign-character equations
ideas.modern_name: Explicit description of a subgroup scheme via characters (det, component sign of a torus normalizer); fibre product of groups over G_m and μ_2

ideas.what: Kernel argument: the kernel of the 'global' characters is SR° ≅ ST_ρ × ST_σ, on which the remaining maps are the projections
ideas.modern_name: Injectivity via a kernel computation / dévissage

ideas.what: Surjectivity by locally extracting a square root of the determinant and correcting by a central G_m section

deep.surprise_reason: A routine technical lemma, explicitly self-described as provisional bookkeeping, describing an auxiliary group scheme inside a product of classical groups. It belongs to the private 'loop equation' material, but the content itself is standard group-scheme computation with no new idea or connection visible.
transcription_corrections: Target of (19): read 'G × T_ρ × N'_σ × G_m × μ_2 × μ_2' (one μ_2 factor partly obscured or struck), not just '× G_m × μ_2'.
'l'image de est formée' should read 'dont l'image est formée'.
's'identifient dans sur SR°' should read roughly 's'identifient sur SR°' or 'induits sur SR°'.
On the next page, 'Coulhain[?]' should read 'Corollaire'.
Page numbering: Grothendieck's own number at the top (536-537) differs from the archive count 467 written in the margin.
